```{r}
library(here)
library(arrow)
library(ragg)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(broom)
library(ggforce)

source(here("functions.R"))
theme_set(figTheme())

figs <- list()

targets <- list()
targets$order <- c("C3a", "C5a", "sC5b9", "fB", "fH", "CFHR5")
targets$labels <- c("C3a" = "C3a", "C5a" = "C5a", "sC5b9" = "sC5b-9", "fB" = "Factor B", "fH" = "Factor H", "CFHR5" = "CFHR5")
```

# Soma

Import
```{r}
soma_info <- readRDS(here("00_setup/data/metadata.analytes.rds"))
tidy_counts <- read_parquet(here("00_setup/data/count_tidy.postQC.parquet"))
soma_res <- read_csv(here("01_differential_abundance/data/limma.ref_dx.csv"))
# complement soma IDs
complement_soma <- read_csv(here("03_complement/data/complement_somamer_ids.csv")) %>%
  left_join(soma_res,by="apt_id")
```

N SOMAmers
```{r}
nrow(complement_soma)
```
```{r}
complement_soma$Target %>% unique() %>% length()
```

## Differential abundance of complement proteins measured via somascan

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=10}
# combine
complement_sum_stats <- complement_soma %>%
  mutate(target_label=paste0(Target, " (",SeqId,")"),
         apt_label = factor(apt_id, levels = complement_soma$apt_id, labels = target_label),
         section=factor(section, levels = c("Lectin","Classical","C4","C2","C3","Alternative","C5","MAC","Regulatory")),
         asterisk=if_else(adj.P.Val<0.05,"*",NA))
logFC_range <- c(min(complement_sum_stats$logFC),max(complement_sum_stats$logFC))

plotComplementHeatmap <- function(sections){
  filter(complement_sum_stats,section %in% sections) %>%
    arrange(P.Value) |>
    distinct(Target, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = "x", y=apt_label)) +
    geom_tile(aes(fill=logFC)) +
    geom_text(aes(label = asterisk), size = 5, colour = "black") +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "#00344aff",
      mid = "#f5f5f5ff",
      high = "#b53737ff",
      guide = guide_colorbar(
        frame.colour = "black",
        ticks.colour = "black",
      ), limits = logFC_range
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0),limits=rev) +
    facet_wrap(~section,scales="free_y") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "SomaScan log<sub>2</sub>(FC)") +
    figTheme("box") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          strip.clip = "off")
}

(plotComplementHeatmap(c("Lectin","Classical","Alternative")) /
plotComplementHeatmap(c("C4","C2"))/
  plotComplementHeatmap(c("C3"))/
plotComplementHeatmap(c("C5"))/
plotComplementHeatmap(c("MAC")) +
    plot_layout(heights=c(11,3,6,2,7))|
  plotComplementHeatmap(c("Regulatory"))) +
  plot_layout(guides="collect",widths=c(4,1)) &
  theme(legend.position = "top")

```

```{r}
complement_sum_stats |> glimpse() |>
  select(apt_id, section,logFC,AveExpr, t,P.Value,adj.P.Val,TargetFullName, Target,EntrezGeneSymbol) |>
  arrange(P.Value) |> write_csv(here("supp_data/complement_soma_limma.csv"))
```

# ELISA QC

Import
```{r}
elisa <- readRDS(here("03_complement/data/elisa.tidy.rds"))
meta <- readRDS(here("03_complement/data/elisa.metadata.rds"))
```

## Outliers

### PCA

```{r}
pca_obj <- elisa |>
  select(target, study_id, log2_concentration) |>
  pivot_wider(id_cols=study_id, names_from = "target",values_from = "log2_concentration", values_fill = NA) |>
  column_to_rownames("study_id") |>
  as.matrix() |>
  prcomp(center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
```

PCA biplot coloured by GCA diagnosis
```{r}
pca_obj$x |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  rownames_to_column("study_id") |>
  left_join(meta,by="study_id") |>
  ggplot(aes(x=PC1, y=PC2)) +
geom_point(aes(colour=ref_dx))
```

Run PCA outlier analysis
```{r}
pca_outliers <- outlierPCA(pca_obj,sdLimit = 5)
```


```{r}
pca_outliers$outliers
```

Exclude PCA outliers
```{r}
elisa <- elisa |> filter(!study_id %in% pca_outliers$outliers)
meta <- meta |> filter(!study_id %in% pca_outliers$outliers)
```



## Target outliers

```{r}
zscore_qc <- elisa |>
  mutate(zscore_log2_concentration=scale(log2_concentration, center=TRUE, scale=TRUE), .by=target) |>
  mutate(rank = dense_rank(zscore_log2_concentration),.by=target) |>
  # add label so we can remove samples on a per target basis
  mutate(target_study_id = paste(target, study_id, sep = "_"))


zscore_outliers <- zscore_qc |> filter(abs(zscore_log2_concentration)>3) |>
  select(study_id, target, target_study_id)
```
Plot
```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=6}
zscore_qc |>
mutate(Outlier = if_else(target_study_id %in% zscore_outliers$target_study_id, "Yes", "No"),
       target = factor(target,levels = targets$order, labels=targets$labels)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = rank, y=zscore_log2_concentration)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept=3, linetype="dashed",alpha=0.25) +
 geom_hline(yintercept=-3, linetype="dashed",alpha=0.25) +
  geom_point(aes(colour=Outlier)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values=c("No" = "grey", "Yes" = "red")) +
  facet_wrap(~target, scale="free") +
  labs(x = "Ranked samples", y= "Z score") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x=element_blank())

ggsave(here("figures/annotated/supp_elisa_outliers.png"), device=agg_png,dpi=600,height=4,width=6)
```
How many?
```{r}
zscore_outliers |> count(target)
```

Outlier breakdown per study group
```{r}
zscore_outliers |> left_join(select(meta,study_id, ref_dx),by="study_id")
```


Exclude outliers
```{r}
elisa <- elisa |>
  mutate(target_study_id = paste(target, study_id, sep = "_")) |>
  filter(!target_study_id %in% zscore_outliers$target_study_id)

saveRDS(elisa, here("03_complement/data/elisa.postQC.rds"))
```

ELISA-SomaScan correlation

Function for plotting
```{r}
plotSomaELISA <- function(elisaTarget, aptID){
elisa_measurement <- elisa |> filter(target==elisaTarget)
soma_measurement <- tidy_counts |> filter(apt_id==aptID) |> mutate(target = elisaTarget) |>
  left_join(soma_info |> mutate(target_label = paste0(Target, " (",SeqId,")")) |>
              select(apt_id, target_label),by="apt_id")
plot_df <- inner_join(elisa_measurement,soma_measurement,by=c("target", "study_id"))
spearman_cor <- tidy(cor.test(~log2_concentration + log2_RFU, data=plot_df,method="spearman"))
plot_df |>
  ggplot(aes(y = log2_concentration,x=log2_RFU)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = paste0(unique(soma_measurement$target_label), "<br>(log<sub>2</sub> RFU)"),
       y = paste0("ELISA concentration<br>(log<sub>2</sub> ng/mL)"),
       subtitle = paste0("Spearman's rho = ",round(spearman_cor$estimate,2), "<br>",
                         formatPvalLabel(spearman_cor$p.value, includeP = TRUE)),
       title=elisaTarget)
}
```


C3a, C5a, Factor B, Factor H, CFHR5

# Linear regression

Testing difference in target log2 concentration between GCA and non-GCA adjusting for age, sex, elisa plate and treatment days

```{r}
lm_res <- elisa |>
  mutate(target = factor(target,levels = targets$order, labels=targets$labels)) |>
  left_join(meta,by="study_id") |>
  group_by(target) |>
  do(tidy(lm(log2_concentration ~ ref_dx + poly(age_at_dx,2) + sex + elisa_plate + poly(gc_days,2), data = .))) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(term=="ref_dxGCA") |>
  mutate(fdr=p.adjust(p.value,method="fdr"))
lm_res
```

Export LM results for supp data
```{r}
lm_res |>
  select(-term) |>
  write_csv(here("supp_data/elisa_lm.csv"))
```


Concentration boxplots

```{r}
 conc <-  elisa |>
  left_join(select(meta,study_id,ref_dx),by="study_id") |>
  mutate(target = factor(target,levels = targets$order, labels=targets$labels))
n_samples_per_target <- conc |> count(target,ref_dx)

(figs$boxplots <- map(c("C3a", "C5a", "sC5b-9", "Factor B", "Factor H", "CFHR5"), \(x) conc |>
    filter(target==x) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = ref_dx, y=log2_concentration)) +
  geom_jitter(aes(colour=ref_dx), width = 0.25) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha=0.5,width=0.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = col.dx,guide="none") +
  geom_richtext(data = filter(lm_res,target==x), aes(x = 1.5, y = Inf, label = paste0(
    "β = ", round(estimate, 2), "<br>",
    "FDR <i>P</i> = ", map_chr(fdr, \(x) formatPvalLabel(x, includeP = F, digits = 2))
  )), vjust = 0.75, fill = NA, label.color = NA, size = 3.5) +
    # sample n
    geom_text(data=filter(n_samples_per_target,target==x), aes(x = ref_dx, y = -Inf, label = paste0("n = ", n)), vjust=-0.5,size=3) +
  coord_cartesian(clip="off") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.15, 0.25))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y= "log<sub>2</sub> concentration<br>(ng/mL)",title=x)+
    theme(plot.title=element_markdown(face="bold"))) |> wrap_plots())
```
